en.basel-kadem: 2.	Abdul-Rahman bin Abbas said, and he ascribed it, saying:

Mua’wiya asked Hasan bin Ali, peace be upon them both, about manliness, so he said: A man’s avariciousness towards his religion, his rectification of his property and establishment of rights. Mu’awiya then said: You did well, O father of Muhammed! You did well, O father of Muhammed! He said: Mu’awiya then used to say after that: I had wished that Yazid said it [1], and he was, indeed, half-blinded.
